cohort: 115 mothers with SARS-CoV-2 and singleton pregnancies in Chapel Hill, NC
finding: While most mothers and infants had a routine clinical course, moderate and severe maternal COVID-19 infections were associated with pregnancy complications and premature delivery, particularly in mothers with pre-existing diabetes.
mod_finding: Moderate and severe maternal infections were associated with increased C-section and premature delivery.
